artifactRequest.configuration: README-stated scenario: train.py --config configs/distill.json (working directory not recorded; README wording suggests samples/configured_training). --config is the only CLI flag, so no overrides are possible and run() reads every key with config[...] and no defaults: student=small, teacher=wide, teacher_checkpoint=external/teacher.pt, train_data=external/train.pt, validation_data=external/validation.pt, alpha=0.6, temperature=2.0, learning_rate=0.001, epochs=5, output=student.pt. Hard-coded in source rather than configured: batch_size=32, Adam optimizer, CPU map_location.
artifactRequest.question: Explain training selected by samples/configured_training/configs/distill.json. Resolve model registry entries, teacher freezing, both loss terms, student-only updates, validation and checkpoint output. State unknown external data and checkpoint facts.
artifactRequest.scope: One scenario only: samples/configured_training/train.py launched with --config pointing at configs/distill.json. Covers config loading, registry resolution, teacher checkpoint load and freezing, data loading, the per-batch distillation step, per-epoch validation, and final checkpoint output. infer.py is a separate entrypoint shown only as a downstream consumer of the saved checkpoint; it is not part of the selected run.

claims.summary: The launch scenario and direct JSON configuration flow are accurately separated from hard-coded settings.
Small and wide resolve to compatible 10-input, 3-output architectures.
Load, freeze, eval-mode, and no-grad steps are all grounded in source.
The artifact correctly distinguishes hard-label CE, temperature-scaled KL, and the 0.4/0.6 blend.
Adam is constructed from student parameters and the shown update therefore applies to student state only.
Per-epoch validation output and the one final student state save are accurately distinguished.
The external teacher compatibility and quality are correctly unresolved; suggested preflight checks are advice rather than observed behavior.
The loader contract is supported, while dataset schema, overlap, and quality remain external runtime facts.
The separate inference consumer is kept outside the selected training run.
